title: adoption-verdict
description: Frontmatter of an adoption verdict: the shared frontmatter, one of the three verdicts of CAP-44.h, brought into Wave 2 lite by Contract v4.2 (DEC-722), and the required list of named conditions behind it (DEC-741 I (ii)). Each condition has its name, its source item and its state, one of `met`, `not met` and `accepted`; an `accepted` condition names the owner entry that accepts it (DEC-741 answer F). The schema states the shape only: whether the verdict agrees with its conditions is asked elsewhere, not here.

verdict.description: The verdict, one of the three of CAP-44.h.

conditions.description: The named conditions behind the verdict, in the lite form Contract v4.2 states (DEC-741 I (ii)).

condition.description: One condition: its name, the item of the Contract or the register it comes from, and its state. An `accepted` condition names the owner entry, a decision id, that accepts it (DEC-741 answer F).

state.description: Whether the condition holds: met, not met, or accepted by an owner entry.
